sn35.28:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā gayāyaṃ viharati gayāsīse saddhiṃ bhikkhusahassena.
sn35.28:1.5: cakkhuṃ bhikkhave, ādittaṃ, rūpā ādittā, cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, cakkhusamphasso āditto. yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.7: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi. sotaṃ ādittaṃ. saddā ādittā, sotaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, sotasamphasso āditto. yampidaṃ sotasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ. kena ādittaṃ: ādittaṃ rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi. ghānaṃ ādittaṃ, gandhā ādittā, ghānaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, ghānasamphasso āditto. yampidaṃ ghānasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ. kena ādittaṃ: ādittaṃ rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi.
sn35.28:1.8: jivhā ādittā, rasā ādittā, jivhāviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, jivhāsamphasso āditto. yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.10: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāmaraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi. kāyo āditto, phoṭṭhabbā ādittā, kāyaviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, kāyasamphasso āditto. yampidaṃ kāyasamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ. kena ādittaṃ: ādittaṃ rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ, jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi.
sn35.28:1.11: mano āditto, dhammā ādittā, manoviññāṇaṃ ādittaṃ, manosamphasso āditto. manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi ādittaṃ.
sn35.28:1.13: rāgagginā dosagginā mohagginā, ādittaṃ jātiyā jarāmaraṇena, sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi ādittanti vadāmi.
sn35.28:1.14: evampassaṃ bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati, yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe… jivhāyapi nibbindati, rasesupi nibbindati, jivhāviññāṇepi nibbindati, jivhāsamphassepi nibbindati, yampidaṃ jivhāsamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati …pe… manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati,
sn35.28:1.15: yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tasmimpi nibbindati.
sn35.28:1.16: nibbindaṃ virajjati. virāgā vimuccati. vimuttasmiṃ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṃ hoti.
sn35.28:1.17: khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, nāparaṃ itthattāyāti pajānātī ti.
sn35.28:2.2: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
sn35.28:2.3: imasmiñca pana veyyākaraṇasmiṃ bhaññamāne tassa bhikkhusahassassa anupādāya āsavehi cittāni vimucciṃsūti.
